incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired: routing.service.latency.p50 > 300ms (prod) — 3 triggers in 2m — https://pagerduty.example/alerts/INC12345 :rotating_light:
kenji (oncall): ack'd. i'm up — pulling up dashboards
sam (sre): on call with kenji, looking at router-pool metrics. seeing CPU bump and a cluster of slow tails on pool-3
kenji (oncall): running quick check: `kubectl get pods -l app=router -n prod -o wide`
kenji (oncall): logs show repeated 502/503 from upstream timeouts for a handful of instances:
```
2026-03-14T11:02:17Z router-3 - request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream_timeout
2026-03-14T11:02:18Z router-7 - request_id=def456 status=503 connection_reset
```
alisa: any customer-facing errors reported? maria (support): i see 4 customers with error traces in last 5m, all on eu-west region — low-volume but visible. i've alerted the CS leads
kenji (oncall): thanks. routing SLO error budget should be fine but we need to contain
sam (sre): checking autoscaler logs — seems an autoscale cooldown delayed new pods. suspected ooms? `kubectl describe hpa router`
kenji (oncall): trying a manual scale: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/router -n prod`
jordan: pinging infra host team to confirm no noisy noisy maintenance windows
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to next responder in 5m (no resolution yet)
kenji (oncall): scaled, warming new replicas. adding a temporary route drain on the affected nodes:
```
for node in node-3 node-7; do kubectl cordon $node && drain $node; done
```
alisa: nice, any immediate drop in errors?
kenji (oncall): errors dropping — p50 latency trending down. still seeing scattered 502s but overall improving
maria (support): customers notified: small number, CS monitoring. no outage declared
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (INC12345) — no escalation required — auto-resolve after 6m of recovery :white_check_mark:
kenji (oncall): confirmed resolved. handing off notes to alisa for postmortem follow-up — i'll update runbook with tweak to HPA cooldown and increase min replicas in eu-west
alisa: noted. i'll open a follow-up ticket and tag `#postmortem` — assigning to sam and kenji. suggested action: raise p50 alert threshold or add suppression window for short spikes
sam (sre): agree. also want to add a probe to detect HPA cooldown stalls. putting proposed changes in PR
kenji (oncall): final: no broad customer impact but noisy alert. recommend changing alert to require 3/4 buckets > threshold or 90s sustained before page. tagging deliverables:
- infra: investigate autoscaler logs (sam)
- oncall/runbooks: update HPA cooldown + min replicas (kenji)
- product/support: notify CS of follow-up (maria)
alisa: thanks team. closing thread, will follow up in ticket. :slightly_smiling_face:
